title: Not as described
text: Not as described. This is more like a cooler than a lunch bag. It's way too big to take to work.

product_metadata.title: MIER Adult Lunch Box Insulated Lunch Bag Large Cooler Tote Bag for Men, Women, Double Deck Cooler (Dark Grey, Large)
features: 2 Compartment Lunch Bag ---- The top "dry" section boasts a yawning U-opening and dual zipper pulls for automatic access, ideal for non-seeping items like fruits, snacks or pies. The bottom "cold" section is no-leak insulated with soft PEVA liner, perfect for drinks, water, juice and suchlike. Easy to clean

Insulated Lunch Bag ---- The thick inner insulation and food-grade safe PEVA liner retain coldness or warmth, it can keep food stay cold/warm/fresh for hours, the heat-welded seams to guard against leaks; Easy to wipe clean. Top section interior size is 9.45L*7W*5.5H inch, Bottom section interior size is 9.45L*7W*4.7H inch

Comfy to Carry ---- The detachable and adjustable shoulder strap for easy carrying. Besides, the adjustable length (MIN: 31.5", MAX:55.5") fits most people around the shoulder at the drop of a hat for a hands-free carrying experience. MIER special design 2.0 silicon handle ensures you have a comfortable grip

High Reliable Cooler ---- A front zipper pouch for packing utensils and napkins, two small side pockets to accommodate other belongings like cards, keys or snacks, making this thermo tote more convenient and flexible. Two sizes available and come in totally 13 amazing colors

Limited Manufacturer's Warranty ---- TWO-YEAR for MIER lunch bag. We stand behind our products. If a product fails because of a defect in material or the quality of workmanship, we will repair or replace it free of charge. MIER takes pride in the quality of our products and warrants that the materials and workmanship will be free of any defects. Our factories follow a strict set of specifications and quality standards, however, if a problem develops, please contact us
